brands.description: Old Admiral is an Indian brandy from Radico Khaitan, launched in 2002. It is known for a rich taste and aromatic finish.
brands.story: Radico Khaitan introduced Old Admiral in 2002 as part of its Indian brandy range. The label remains a familiar choice for drinkers looking for a warm, aromatic brandy style.

tasting_notes.title: Aroma and style
tasting_notes.description: Rich brandy character with an aromatic finish.

tasting_notes.title: Character
tasting_notes.description: Warm fruit and gentle sweetness make it a natural fit for a relaxed after-dinner pour.

how_to_enjoy.description: Serve a measured pour in a small brandy glass, with water alongside.
Try it with tandoori chicken, seekh kebab, or dark chocolate.

brands.why_choose: A straightforward Indian brandy with a rich, aromatic style and an easy after-dinner serve.

faqs.question: What is Old Admiral?
faqs.answer: Old Admiral is an Indian brandy listed in Radico Khaitan's domestic portfolio.

faqs.question: How should I serve Old Admiral?
faqs.answer: Try a small pour in a brandy glass, with water alongside, or pair it with tandoori chicken and dark chocolate.

brands.final_verdict: Old Admiral is a warm, aromatic Indian brandy that works well neat, with water, or alongside rich grilled food.
brands.meta_description: Old Admiral brandy guide with tasting style, Indian pairings, serving ideas, and city-level prices and availability on BevOry.

tasting_notes.title: Serve

how_to_enjoy.description: Begin with a small neat pour, then add water or soda to taste.

faqs.question: What is Regal Talon?

brands.description: Whytehall is an Indian brandy from Radico Khaitan. The brand is described with a warm, full-bodied style and a lingering finish.
brands.story: Whytehall is part of Radico Khaitan's Indian brandy range. Its public presentation centres on warmth, body, and a lasting finish, making it suited to slow, food-led serves.

tasting_notes.title: Body
tasting_notes.description: Warm and full-bodied, with a lingering finish.

tasting_notes.title: Style
tasting_notes.description: A rounded brandy profile that suits a small neat pour or a restrained highball.

how_to_enjoy.description: Use a rocks glass for a small pour, or build a restrained highball.
Try it with tandoori chicken, peppery kebabs, or aged cheddar.

brands.why_choose: Its warm, full-bodied character makes Whytehall a natural choice for brandy drinkers who enjoy a lingering finish.

faqs.question: What category is Whytehall?
faqs.answer: Radico Khaitan currently lists Whytehall as brandy in its domestic portfolio.

faqs.question: How should I serve Whytehall?
faqs.answer: Use a rocks glass for a small pour, or build a restrained highball with a light mixer.

brands.final_verdict: Whytehall is a warm, full-bodied Indian brandy that suits a slow neat pour, a light highball, and savoury grilled food.
brands.meta_description: Whytehall brandy guide with producer context, Indian pairings, serving ideas, and city-level prices on BevOry.

brands.description: Pluton Bay is an Indian premium rum from Radico Khaitan, made with aged cane juice and neutral spirits. Its dark colour and spicy profile give it a bold place in the Indian rum category.
brands.story: Pluton Bay brings a dark, spice-led rum style to Radico Khaitan's domestic range. The label is made for drinkers who enjoy richer rum flavours with ginger, tropical fruit, and chocolate-led pairings.

tasting_notes.title: Aroma
tasting_notes.description: Vanilla, caramel, tropical fruit, and oak.

tasting_notes.title: Palate
tasting_notes.description: Dark, spicy rum character with a smooth texture and a warming finish.

how_to_enjoy.description: Try a measured pour over ice or with a dry ginger mixer.
Pair with seekh kebab, grilled pineapple, or dark chocolate.

brands.why_choose: A dark, spicy Indian rum suited to ice, dry ginger, tropical fruit, and food-led pours.

faqs.question: What is Pluton Bay?
faqs.answer: Pluton Bay is a rum brand in Radico Khaitan's domestic portfolio.

faqs.question: What pairs well with Pluton Bay?
faqs.answer: Try it with seekh kebab, grilled pineapple, dark chocolate, or a dry ginger mixer.

brands.final_verdict: Pluton Bay is a bold, dark Indian rum with vanilla, caramel, spice, and tropical depth for relaxed pours over ice or with ginger.
brands.meta_description: Pluton Bay rum guide with cane-juice style, Indian pairings, serving ideas, and city-level prices and availability on BevOry.

brands.description: Ankahi Zaffran is a saffron-spiced liqueur introduced by Radico Khaitan in 2025. Its warm spice character suits small pours, dessert pairings, and carefully balanced cocktails.

tasting_notes.title: Aroma
tasting_notes.description: Warm saffron spice with a sweet liqueur character.

tasting_notes.title: Style
tasting_notes.description: Rich, dessert-friendly and best enjoyed in a measured pour.

how_to_enjoy.description: Serve a measured chilled pour or use a controlled amount in a cocktail.
Try it with pistachio kulfi, dark chocolate, or salted nuts.

brands.why_choose: A saffron-spiced liqueur for small pours, dessert-led cocktails, and drinkers looking for an Indian flavour profile.

faqs.question: What is Ankahi Zaffran?
faqs.answer: It is a spiced liqueur identified in Radico Khaitan's 2025 product updates.

faqs.question: How can I serve Ankahi Zaffran?
faqs.answer: Serve it chilled in a small glass, or add a measured amount to a dessert cocktail with chocolate, coffee, or cream.

brands.final_verdict: Ankahi Zaffran offers a warm saffron-spice profile that is most at home in small pours and dessert-led serves.
brands.meta_description: Ankahi Zaffran liqueur guide with saffron-spiced style, Indian pairings, serving ideas, and city-level prices on BevOry.

brands.description: Morpheus Blue XO Premium Brandy is an Indian XO blended brandy from Radico Khaitan. Its official profile features dried fruit, nuts, mature oak, vanilla, caramel, and a long smooth finish.
brands.story: Morpheus Blue is part of Radico Khaitan's Morpheus brandy family and is presented as an XO blend. Its profile moves from dried fruit and nuts into mature oak, vanilla, and caramel.

tasting_notes.title: Nose
tasting_notes.description: Intense fruity and floral notes with raisin, prune, and nuts.

tasting_notes.title: Palate and finish
tasting_notes.description: Heavy-bodied and honeyed, with matured oak, vanilla, and caramel followed by a long smooth finish.

how_to_enjoy.description: Use a small tulip or brandy glass; taste it neat before adding water.
Pair with dark chocolate, roasted nuts, or a mild fruit dessert.

brands.why_choose: Its dried-fruit, nut, oak, vanilla, and caramel profile gives Morpheus Blue a clear after-dinner identity.

faqs.question: What is Morpheus Blue?
faqs.answer: Morpheus Blue is an XO blended premium brandy from Radico Khaitan.

faqs.question: What does Morpheus Blue taste like?
faqs.answer: The official profile lists fruity and floral aromas, raisin, prune, nuts, oak, vanilla, caramel, and a long smooth finish.

brands.final_verdict: Morpheus Blue is a rich XO brandy for slow sipping, with dried fruit, nuts, oak, vanilla, and caramel leading into a smooth finish.
brands.meta_description: Morpheus Blue XO brandy guide with raisin, prune, oak and caramel notes, pairings, and city-level prices on BevOry.

brands.description: Four Seasons is an Indian wine label with a range shaped by grape and colour. Its business history is connected with Grover Zampa Vineyards after the 2019 sale of the Four Seasons wine business and associated brands.
brands.story: Four Seasons grew as an Indian wine label and later became part of the wider Grover Zampa business story. The range is best explored through its different colours, grapes, and styles rather than one single flavour description.

tasting_notes.title: Range
tasting_notes.description: The wines move across different styles, so aroma, acidity, body, and fruit character change with grape and colour.

tasting_notes.title: Wine style
tasting_notes.description: Fresh whites, roses, and fuller reds each bring a different drinking experience to the table.

how_to_enjoy.description: Follow the exact label temperature in a clean wine glass.
Start with tandoori fish, paneer tikka, tomato pasta, or roast chicken depending on the bottle style.

brands.why_choose: A broad Indian wine label for exploring different colours and grape-led styles with familiar food.

faqs.question: What is Four Seasons?
faqs.answer: Four Seasons is an Indian wine label associated with Four Seasons Wines and the Grover Zampa group history.

faqs.question: How should I choose a Four Seasons wine?
faqs.answer: Start with the colour and grape on the bottle, then match the wine to the food and the occasion.

brands.final_verdict: Four Seasons is a versatile Indian wine label; choose by colour and grape, then serve it chilled or lightly aerated as the style requires.
brands.meta_description: Four Seasons wine guide with style, food pairings, serving ideas, and city-level prices and availability on BevOry.

brands.description: Vallonne Vineyards is an Indian boutique wine estate founded by Shailendra Pai in 2009 at Kavnai, Igatpuri, near Nashik. Its range includes Chenin Blanc, Riesling, Viognier, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Syrah, a Cabernet Sauvignon rose, and a dessert wine made with sundried grapes.
brands.story: Vallonne began in 2009 at Kavnai, Igatpuri, near Nashik, with a focus on estate-led Indian wines. The estate works across aromatic whites, classic red grapes, rose, and a dessert wine made from sundried grapes.

tasting_notes.title: White wines
tasting_notes.description: Riesling and Viognier bring aromatic white-wine styles, while Chenin Blanc adds a fresh, versatile profile.

tasting_notes.title: Red and dessert wines
tasting_notes.description: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Syrah bring darker fruit and structure; the sundried-grape dessert wine belongs to a richer, sweeter style.

how_to_enjoy.description: Serve white and rosé wines chilled; give reds a little air in a wide wine glass.
Try with malai chicken tikka, tandoori crab, Thai curries, or mushroom dishes.

brands.why_choose: A focused Indian estate with aromatic whites, structured reds, rose, and a distinctive sundried-grape dessert wine.

faqs.question: Where is Vallonne from?
faqs.answer: Vallonne Vineyards is based at Kavnai, Igatpuri, near Nashik, India.

faqs.question: Which grapes are listed by the estate?
faqs.answer: The estate lists Chenin Blanc, Riesling, Viognier, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Syrah, along with rose and dessert-wine styles.

brands.final_verdict: Vallonne is a thoughtful Indian wine estate for drinkers who want to explore aromatic whites, structured reds, and a distinctive dessert wine.

brands.description: Charosa Vineyards is an Indian wine estate in Charosa village, in Nashik's Dindori sub-region, spread across about 230 acres. Its portfolio uses Pleasures, Selections, and Reserve tiers, with documented grapes including Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon, Shiraz, Sauvignon Blanc, and Viognier.
brands.story: Charosa Vineyards is rooted in Charosa village in Nashik's Dindori sub-region. The estate organises its wines across Pleasures, Selections, and Reserve tiers, giving drinkers a clear path from approachable bottles to more detailed expressions.

tasting_notes.title: Reserve Tempranillo
tasting_notes.description: Ripe red fruit with vanilla, coconut, and chocolate.

tasting_notes.title: Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
tasting_notes.description: Ripe fruit, black olive, vanilla, and balanced tannins.

tasting_notes.title: Selection Viognier
tasting_notes.description: Floral and apricot character with a bright, aromatic finish.

how_to_enjoy.description: Serve whites chilled and let Reserve reds breathe in a wide wine glass.
Try the whites with paneer tikka or grilled fish, and Reserve Tempranillo with lamb rogan josh.

brands.why_choose: A Nashik estate with tiered wines, recognisable Indian grapes, and a broad range of red and white styles.

faqs.question: Where is Charosa Vineyards?
faqs.answer: The estate is in Charosa village in Nashik's Dindori sub-region.

faqs.question: What wine tiers are documented?
faqs.answer: The portfolio documents Pleasures, Selections, and Reserve tiers.

brands.final_verdict: Charosa is a strong choice for exploring Nashik wine, from floral Viognier and fresh whites to structured Reserve reds.
brands.meta_description: Explore Charosa's Nashik wines, Reserve Tempranillo, estate grapes, Indian pairings, and city-level prices on BevOry.
